## Checklist

- [ ] A failing test came first (red), then the change (green)
- [ ] The touched projects' tests and lint pass ([docs/TESTING.md](../docs/TESTING.md))
- [ ] `python3 make/docs.py --check` passes
- [ ] A protocol change updates docs/PROTOCOL.md, conformance/ and CHANGELOG.md together
- [ ] No new third-party dependency in the core (`sage/`)
- [ ] No recordings or transcripts of real people, no tokens, no `.env`, no LAN addresses or home paths
- [ ] Pushed from a `<project>/<topic>` branch, never a local-only one
